item.title: National Guard members speak candidly about D.C. deployment
item.description: As the National Guard deployment to Washington, D.C., enters its second year, three members who served extended tours share their experiences.

item.title: Washington, D.C.'s first IndyCar race draws crowds to National Mall
item.description: IndyCar drivers raced past iconic landmarks over the weekend, facing unique challenges on an unconventional course.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announces new U.S. sanctions against Iran
item.description: The Trump administration describes the move as "economic D-Day" on Iran, which has vowed a "seismic" response.

item.title: Former deputy convicted in Sonya Massey shooting dies in prison, lawyer confirms
item.description: Sean Grayson, the ex-deputy found guilty of killing Sonya Massey, has died in prison, according to his attorney.
